modmenu.descriptionTranslation.bloodvign: Pulsing blood-red vignette and warning icon at low health.
config.bloodvignette.title: Blood Vignette Settings
config.bloodvignette.enable_vignette.too: Show a pulsing red vignette around the screen when your health is low.
config.bloodvignette.enable_icon.tooltip: Show a warning icon when your health is low.
config.bloodvignette.health_threshold.to: Effects turn on when health is at or below this value (1–20). Default 6 = 3 hearts.
config.bloodvignette.pulse_strength.tool: How strong the pulse animation is (0.0–1.0).
config.bloodvignette.icon_opacity.toolti: How opaque the warning icon is (0.0 = invisible, 1.0 = fully visible).
config.bloodvignette.icon_size.tooltip: Size of the warning icon in pixels (16–128). Default 48.
config.bloodvignette.icon_pos_y.tooltip: Vertical position (0.0 = top, 0.18 = upper area, 1.0 = bottom).
config.bloodvignette.fade_in_ms.tooltip: How long the vignette and icon take to appear (0–2000 ms). 0 = instant.
config.bloodvignette.fade_out_ms.tooltip: How long the vignette and icon take to disappear (0–2000 ms). 0 = instant.
